topicName: API Governance: Linting and Spectral Rules
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"API Governance: Linting and Spectral Rules in Postman"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction to API Governance"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"API governance ensures that all APIs across an organization adhere to consistent design standards, security policies, and style guidelines. Postman integrates Stoplight Spectral, an open-source JSON/YAML linter, directly into the workspace to automate this process."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding Spectral and Rulesets"},{"order":5,"type":"paragraph","text":"Spectral uses rulesets defined in YAML or JSON format to validate OpenAPI specifications. These rules enforce naming conventions, required fields, and structural standards before code is even written."},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Configuring a Custom Spectral Ruleset"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a spectral.yaml file in your repository to define custom linting rules. Below is an example that enforces operation descriptions and camelCase naming for parameters."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"extends: ["spectral:oas"]
rules:
  operation-description-required:
    description: "All operations must have a description."
    severity: error
    given: "$.paths.*[get,post,put,delete]"
    then:
      field: description
      function: truthy
  parameter-case-convention:
    description: "Parameters must use camelCase."
    severity: warn
    given: "$.paths.*[get,post,put,delete].parameters[*].name"
    then:
      function: casing
      functionOptions:
        type: camel"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Integrating Rulesets into Postman"},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Navigate to your Postman API definition tab."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Select the Governance or Validation section in the sidebar."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Upload or link your custom spectral.yaml ruleset to apply it to your OpenAPI collection."},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"By incorporating Spectral linting into your Postman workflow, you catch design inconsistencies early, ensuring a standardized and maintainable API ecosystem."}]
